title: Energy Demand Forecasting System
subtitle: Machine Learning Project
overview: Time-series forecasting system on Spain energy data achieving 1% MAPE with LSTM.

details.description: Built a comprehensive time-series forecasting pipeline to predict hourly energy demand using statistical and deep learning models.
details.problem: Accurate energy demand forecasting is crucial for grid stability and cost optimization.
details.approach: Implemented ARIMA, Prophet, and LSTM on 35K hourly records (2015–2018). Created automated backtesting and a Streamlit dashboard for comparison.
details.impact: Achieved 1% MAPE with LSTM, reducing forecasting error by 83%.

title: Blockchain-based Voting System
subtitle: Security Project
overview: Decentralized voting platform with privacy-preserving verification.

details.description: Developed a secure digital voting system using a custom blockchain and cryptographic techniques.
details.problem: Traditional voting systems face transparency and tampering concerns.
details.approach: Implemented Python-based blockchain with homomorphic encryption for privacy-preserving vote validation.
details.impact: Enabled verifiable and auditable elections while preserving voter anonymity.

title: Survival Modelling in Post-HCT Patients
subtitle: Healthcare ML
overview: Clinical survival prediction using ensemble ML models.

details.description: Performed survival analysis on censored transplant patient data to identify outcome predictors.
details.problem: Highly censored medical datasets complicate outcome prediction.
details.approach: Feature engineering and model comparison using XGBoost, LightGBM, and CatBoost.
details.impact: Achieved 0.79 AUC in patient outcome prediction.

title: Vision-based Navigational Autonomous Vehicle
subtitle: Robotics Project
overview: Autonomous robot using YOLOv5 for real-time navigation.

details.description: Designed a navigation robot with computer vision and multi-sensor fusion.
details.problem: Autonomous navigation requires reliable real-time obstacle detection.
details.approach: Used YOLOv5 on Jetson Nano with ultrasonic and IR sensors integrated via Arduino and ESP32.
details.impact: Enabled dynamic speed control and accurate point-to-point navigation.

title: Crop Recommendation System
subtitle: Data Science Project
overview: ML system recommending optimal crops using long-term agricultural data.

details.description: Built a predictive system to recommend top crops based on soil and climate data.
details.problem: Farmers struggle to select crops that maximize yield.
details.approach: Performed cleaning, merging, and regression modeling on 30 years of data.
details.impact: Achieved 0.84 R² and delivered top-5 crop predictions.

title: Real-Time Sign Language Recognition
subtitle: Embedded ML
overview: Sensor-based glove system translating gestures to speech.

details.description: Built smart gloves capturing hand motion and transmitting data for ML classification.
details.problem: Communication barriers for sign language users.
details.approach: Used flex sensors and IMU sensors with ESP32 and cloud-based Random Forest.
details.impact: Achieved 98% classification accuracy with real-time TTS output.

details.description: Designed a low-cost smart home system with safety and automation features.
details.problem: Smart home solutions are often expensive and complex.
details.approach: Integrated ESP32 with gas, smoke, and thermal sensors plus irrigation automation.

details.description: Built CNC system to reproduce text and drawings with high precision.
details.problem: Automated handwriting replication requires fine motor control.
details.approach: Programmed G-code interpreter controlling stepper motors on a custom frame.

title: Collision Avoidance Bot
subtitle: Robotics Project
overview: Autonomous robot with dynamic obstacle avoidance.

details.description: Built a robot that adjusts speed based on real-time distance sensing.
details.problem: Robots require adaptive navigation in cluttered spaces.
details.approach: Used ultrasonic sensors and proportional control algorithms.
details.impact: Enabled safe navigation in variable environments.

title: Automatic Result Collection Bot
subtitle: Automation Project
overview: Selenium bot for automated academic result scraping.

details.description: Created a bot to retrieve and organize student results automatically.
details.problem: Manual result collection is repetitive and slow.
details.approach: Used Selenium WebDriver with structured storage logic.
details.impact: Saved significant manual effort for bulk result retrieval.

title: Kaggle 2022 MLDS Survey Analysis
subtitle: Data Analysis
overview: EDA and dashboard on global ML practitioner trends.

details.description: Analyzed Kaggle survey data for industry insights.
details.problem: Understanding global ML trends requires deep data analysis.
details.approach: Performed cleaning, augmentation, and visualization with Streamlit.
details.impact: Identified salary and technology adoption patterns.

title: Unmanned Person-Following Drone
subtitle: Aerial Robotics
overview: Vision-based quadcopter that tracks and follows a person.

details.description: Built a drone capable of autonomous person tracking.
details.problem: Maintaining stable tracking requires robust vision algorithms.
details.approach: Used Jetson Nano with Pixhawk and pixel-based tracking.
